label: 宵闇の花冠
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame DANGEROUS ACTION 宵闇の花冠 by リリス EXACT 2x2. Ordered: frame1 anticipation, frame2 held windup, frame3 powerful release, frame4 recovery. Trajectory: crown glows first, both wings open (130,330),(890,330), palms spread in regal release (300,470),(720,470), return. Adult queen face, original crown, fully dressed. Exaggerated late-game weight and force, distinct readable poses, secondary cape/tail follows with lag. Body sheet only; tiny attached core/palm glow allowed, full attack VFX separate. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 冠から点灯し、翼と両掌を開く大きい発動姿勢。
issues: 発動の翼・髪・赤い光が等分セルの境界を越え、原画左端にも接する。見切れと矩形の余白を修正する。
発動で本体が小さく低く見える。翼を含む外接寸法と胴体縮尺を分けて比較する。
3地点の花冠は別素材の配置で組む。掌の光と別素材の重複を確認する。
